overview: A review generator web app that uses AI to produce realistic, human-sounding customer reviews. Users select a business type (Café, Online Coffee Brand, or SaaS/Tech Product) and a star rating (1–5 stars), then generate a ready-to-use review they can copy and paste anywhere.
features: 3 business type personas: Café, Online Coffee Brand, SaaS/Tech Product
Star rating picker (1–5) with tone-matched review generation
AI-generated reviews following strict human-sounding writing rules
Generate Again button for instant variations
Loading and error states for a smooth experience
Fully responsive mobile and desktop layout
